connector.name: MCP Google Ads
connector.registryDescription: Multi-account Google Ads MCP: campaigns, keywords, search terms, and ad performance.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-google-ads-multi. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ayo-fam account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
